additional_concerns: The source establishes continuing responsibility, but supplies no complete test for effective retention or supervisory discharge. Practical authority and conduct may be evidence; they are not established necessary or sufficient conditions.
Defective records do not alone establish loss of accountability. Conversely, retained accountability does not establish proper records, operational soundness or fulfilment of all underlying duties.
